scope: first flood only; no manuscript-panel assessment

original_source_identity.source_scope: Paths and process IDs are historical identity evidence; replay never resolves or reads them.

method.arithmetic: Saved float32 values promoted to Python float; reductions use math.fsum.
method.checkpoint_layout: Captured little-endian v2, 64-bit size_t and step counters; full payload checked.
method.deposit_volume: Bulk event-deposit volume includes pore space; peak deposition is cumulative through day 12.
method.difference: half-CFL minus baseline; percentage denominator is baseline
method.field_domain: identical physical floodplain cells, including dry cells; fixed within-flood channel mask
method.normalization: Gross prescribed upstream input for one sinusoidal flood, excluding recycling, outlet flux, and signed bed forcing. This is not the checkpoint net external ledger.
method.snapshot_phase: peak is day 12; end is day 20 before migration/aggradation; checkpoint is after remap
method.storage_bounds: Conservative float32 half-ULP storage bounds only; exclude discretization, separate float64 arithmetic error, and CSV rounding.
method.time_step: CFL halves a stability bound; adaptive substeps and other limits need not halve every realized step.

comparison.scope: Completed first-flood CFL sensitivity only; no temporal-convergence order, 580-flood behavior, or manuscript-panel assessment.

plotting_conventions.absolute_mask: active channel cells gray; floodplain values retained
plotting_conventions.below_deposition_display_threshold: values below 1e-6 m white; no clipping in metrics
plotting_conventions.difference_mask: exclude coarse blocks containing any active channel cell in either grid
plotting_conventions.difference_sign: coarse minus arithmetic mean of four fine cells
plotting_conventions.scientific_scope: one first flood; no manuscript-panel reproduction or convergence inference
